messages:
mike: FYI discovered anomalous KMS signer usage during routine audit — rotating signing key tonight. need quick sync on attestation fallback + RBAC before we flip.
anya: ack. timeline? we should put a 30m maintenance advisory if any manual steps needed.
devsec: quick summary of risk: if verification starts failing, orchestrator will mark images as untrusted and pods may restart. plan: keep previous key active for 48h and have attestor try both keys.
sre-lead: can we avoid a global failure mode? suggest staged roll (canary region -> full) and a hard rollback early-exit.
mike: agreed. proposed cut: canary us-west-2 first, 2% traffic for 20m. failure triggers: cosign_verify_errors > 3/min or image_pull_errors > 2% -> auto rollback.
kevin: RBAC question  the old key still needs decrypt/verify ACLs for the runtime account. who will apply the IAM binding?
anya: iam-oncall can apply ephemeral binding. i'll open a short-lived binding with expiry set to 72h. PR and link will be in the issue.
forensics-bot: ALERT: historical signer use detected from unknown principal on 2026-03-19T02:12Z. creating ticket FOR-1122.
mike: ok that's why we're urgent. forensics, can you attach the principal and IP? we need to know if we should revoke older key immediately.
forensics-bot: FOR-1122 attached: principal=svc:old-deploy@redwood, ip=52.14.23.9, region=eu-west-1. activity matches a maintenance window. confidence low.
devsec: given low confidence, rotate key but don't revoke immediately. preserve signatures, enable fallback verification, and log all verification attempts with key_id + requestor.
kevin: logging: current shipper strips kms.resource name. will update log-shipper config to include kms.key_id and principal. few-line change, deployable in 15m.
sre-lead: add prometheus metrics for verification results: attestor_verify_success_total and attestor_verify_fail_total. also export label key_id so we can see if failures spike for new key.
anya: I'll patch the attestor: try verify(new_key) then verify(previous_key) and emit metric labels {key_id: <used-key>}.
mike: BTW include a short note in incident channel so customer-facing teams know image verification noise might appear. I'll draft: "KMS key rotation tonight; minor image restarts possible; tracking"
ops-oncall: I'll monitor. set pager on attestor_verify_fail_total > 5 in 10m. Also add a runbook step: if >10% pods in namespace fail pull, set rollback flag and run previous-image-family rollback script.
kevin: RBAC binding created: iam binding #889 (link: https://internal/iam/bindings/889). expires in 72h.
forensics-bot: FOR-1122 update: principal owner confirmed (svc:old-deploy) — low risk. closing urgent suspicion.
mike: final ask: capture signed-by metadata in image metadata (cosign annotations) and persist to audit store, TTL for signature validity documented in runbook. I'll update runbook: https://internal/runbooks/kms-rotation.
devsec: noted. PR for attestor and log-shipper open: #512 and #513. want one reviewer each.
anya: i'll review now.
ops-oncall: ping me 10m before canary deploy.
mike: thanks all. will post go/no-go in this thread 30m before the window.
